summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, reporting share buybacks and option exercises. The filing details multiple open-market repurchases between March 20 and April 13, 2026, totaling approximately 12.7 million shares at prices ranging from $6.57–$6.82 per share, with no premium. Additionally, 37,000 shares were issued at $5.33 upon exercise of share options. These transactions constitute a capital return program. The company is buying back shares for cancellation, reducing outstanding equity. Watch for continued buyback pace as a signal of management's view of undervaluation.
